description: Estimate top-level Hyrox finish time, compromised running pace band, total `8x1 km` run time, and Riegel 10K/Half/Marathon race equivalents from a standalone 5K time. Stateless public calculator (no auth required, subject to per-IP fair-use rate limits). Use for quick overall finish-time and pace-band estimates; for individual Lap 1–8 station-fatigued splits and Lap 1 blow-up cost use `hyrox_splits`, or use `hyrox_autopsy` to diagnose actual race splits.
